reflections: Quinn is proactive and follows through on spreading information about the repair drive, making them a useful outreach contact.
Opal is coordinating the logistics side of the repair drive and is assigning clear ownership for tracking drop-off spots and item routing.
Dane is responsive and willing to take on concrete operational support once he understands the need.
Opal is coordinating a repair-drive logistics task and is the central organizer for drop-off spots and item routing.
Dane, Noah, Quinn, and Rey are supportive and proactive, each offering to track, ask around, or compare notes.
The group is converging on a shared mapping of drop-off locations, with Opal collecting updates and others contributing local information.
Opal is coordinating a shared drop-off map and is focused on keeping locations and item destinations organized.
The others are responding supportively and offering to compare notes or help track useful drop-off spots.
The interaction is collaborative and operational, with Opal taking the lead on collecting updates and keeping everyone informed.
Opal is the main organizer, keeping the list current and coordinating drop-off details.

Quinn is helping spread the word and is also coordinating around availability and logistics.
Opal is coordinating the repair schedule and keeping everyone updated on drop-off spots and item destinations.
The group is working around school pickup and drop-off, so timing needs to stay flexible and be confirmed early.
Mina, Kira, Quinn, and Faye are all responsive and willing to help by checking updates and adjusting their plans.

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ve already told a couple folks, and I can keep spreading the word about the repair drive.
